mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_post ( post_id, company_id, company_post_title, company_post_content, space_type, area_pyeong, style, construction_detail) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{companyId}, #{companyPostTitle}, #{companyPostContent}, #{spaceType}, #{areaPyeong}, #{style}, #{constructionDetail} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.post_date AS postDate, c.company_id AS companyId, c.company_post_id AS companyPostId, c.company_post_title AS companyPostTitle, c.company_post_content AS companyPostContent, c.space_type AS spaceType, c.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, c.style AS style, c.construction_detail AS constructionDetail, c.company_post_count AS companyPostCount FROM company_post c JOIN post p ON p.post_id = c.post_id WHERE company_post_id = #{companyPostId}

SELECT company_id AS companyId, company_name AS companyName, company_intro AS companyIntro FROM company c JOIN company_detail d ON d.company_detail_id = c.company_detail_id WHERE company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE company_post SET company_post_title = #{companyPostTitle}, company_post_content = #{companyPostContent}, space_type = #{spaceType}, area_pyeong = #{areaPyeong}, style = #{style}, construction_detail = #{constructionDetail} WHERE company_post_id = #{companyPostId}
mapper.select: SELECT company_post_id AS companyPostId, company_post_title AS companyPostTitle, company_post_content AS companyPostContent, space_type AS spaceType, area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, style AS style, construction_detail AS constructionDetail FROM company_post WHERE company_post_id = #{companyPostId}

SELECT c.company_id AS companyId, cp.company_post_id AS companyPostId, p.post_id AS postId, cp.company_post_title AS companyPostTitle, cp.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, cp.style AS style, p.post_date AS postDate FROM company_post cp JOIN post p ON cp.post_id = p.post_id JOIN company c ON cp.company_id = c.company_id ORDER BY p.post_date DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT c.company_id AS companyId, cp.company_post_id AS companyPostId, p.post_id AS postId, cp.company_post_title AS companyPostTitle, cp.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, cp.style AS style, p.post_date AS postDate FROM company_post cp JOIN post p ON cp.post_id = p.post_id JOIN company c ON cp.company_id = c.company_id ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 6

SELECT c.company_id AS companyId, cp.company_post_id AS companyPostId, p.post_id AS postId, cp.company_post_title AS companyPostTitle, cp.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, cp.style AS style, p.post_date AS postDate FROM company_post cp JOIN post p ON cp.post_id = p.post_id JOIN company c ON cp.company_id = c.company_id ORDER BY cp.company_post_like_count DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT c.company_id AS companyId, cp.company_post_id AS companyPostId, p.post_id AS postId, cp.company_post_title AS companyPostTitle, cp.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, cp.style AS style, p.post_date AS postDate, cd.company_addr AS region FROM company_post cp JOIN post p ON cp.post_id = p.post_id JOIN company c ON cp.company_id = c.company_id JOIN company_detail cd ON c.company_detail_id = cd.company_detail_id WHERE cd.company_addr LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{region}, '%') ORDER BY p.post_date DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT company_post_title AS companyPostTitle, company_post_count AS companyPostCount, scrap_count AS scrapCount FROM company_post WHERE company_id = #{companyId} LIMIT 8

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.post_date AS postDate, c.company_post_id AS companyPostId, c.company_id AS companyId, c.company_post_content AS companyPostContent, c.company_post_title AS companyPostTitle, c.space_type AS spaceType, c.construction_detail AS constructionDetail, c.style AS style, c.company_post_count AS companyPostCount, c.company_post_like_count AS companyPostLikeCount FROM company_post c JOIN post p ON c.post_id = p.post_id WHERE company_post_id = #{companyPostId}
